svg.title: Index Translator browser components, reading aloud
svg.desc: The reading controls turn the text into utterances, cut where the server's sentence ends say, and ask the server for each one, as WAV or, when the browser decodes it, an Ogg Opus stream. A player buffers the audio ahead and plays it. The Read aloud button shows a column of buttons to read from any block. a sentence: public/speech-ui.ts → Server API. playback: public/speech-ui.ts → public/speech.ts → public/speech-buffer.ts.

g.text: can this browser decode Ogg Opus
